note: Actual app.frame observation with original rAF scheduling, clamped catch-up, interpolation, events/audio, memory checkpoint, UI/HUD and renderer. Inclusive CPU call wall times overlap; do not sum nested stages. The observer makes no tick/render/event drain/storage/audio calls itself. A slow or unfocused callback environment is not normal presented FPS or actual GPU execution/audio output/paint/RAM. Different real callback schedules cannot use cross-pass HP/RNG equality as an oracle. No user persistent storage is accessed.

native.note: QA instrumentation measures CPU call wall time only, including any synchronous wait and instrumentation overhead. It does not measure GPU execution, FPS or total memory. Stage fields are independent inclusive observations: nested stages overlap and must not be summed.

cost.note: QA measures synchronous CPU call wall time, including waits and observer overhead. Nested stage observations overlap and must not be summed. This is not GPU execution time, presented FPS, paint or total memory. First-observed owner identities are not game/model construction times. Scoped production.drawFrame stages observe only original calls on the existing ProductionArt instance within the innermost enemy/boss/corpse/player/obstacle/decor renderer category; extra hit-light draws remain separate calls. Category and source subtotals overlap their parent stages, and calls are not unique actors. Native classification uses the existing liveRig metadata flag or original live-player ID; baked requires the original atlas format and a string asset ID; unrecognized selections remain unknown. No Canvas method hooks are added for sprite timing. The observer performs no tick, render, pose, draw, pixel read, upload, event drain or scheduling calls.

fixture.note: Explicit density fixture adds normal enemies through spawnEnemy and preserves initial enemies, spawnClock, HP, speed, AI, damage and normal subsequent spawning. Existing Continue/preload/resume UI launches the memory-only checkpoint.
